$description: v0.13.2 — Component-bound semantic size aliases. Closes the validate:tokens gap where component contracts referenced size.{avatar,banner,bottom-nav,calendar,drawer,kanban,list,navbar,phone,popover,sidebar,slider,table,tree}.* without those paths existing anywhere in tokens.json. The aliases point to existing `dimension.*` primitives via the standard alias syntax. Component contracts and CSS consumers reach these via the semantic name; the underlying value cascades from the primitive scale. (Note: `size.container.*`, `size.reading.*`, `size.control.*`, `size.scrollbar`, `size.dot.*` live in `primitives/dimension.tokens.json` — those are the foundation. This file adds the component-shape size aliases on top.)

avatar.$description: Per-tier avatar diameter. Square; rounded-full applies via CSS. Aligned to the control-height ladder so an Avatar in a button row matches the button.

xs.$description: 20 px — inline-text avatar (chat by-line, comment lead-glyph).

sm.$description: 24 px — dense list row, table cell.

md.$description: 32 px — default; sidebar profile chip, comment thread.

regular.$description: 56 px — iOS / Android standard tab bar.

day.$description: 32 px — square day cell. Touch floor honored by tap-area padding around the visible cell on mobile.

drawer.$description: Side Drawer widths. Apply max-width on the Drawer surface; the body width is the drawer width minus body padding.

sm.$description: 256 px — narrow nav drawer / filter panel.

md.$description: 360 px — default Drawer; settings panel, inspector.

lg.$description: 480 px — wide Drawer; detail view, form panel.

column.$description: 280 px — standard Kanban column. Wide enough for a 2-3 line title + tags + meta row; narrow enough that 3+ columns fit on a 1024-wide viewport.

compact.$description: 40 px — dense settings list, operator inbox.

regular.$description: 48 px — default list row. Touch-target floor (44) honored by inner tap-area padding.

comfortable.$description: 56 px — marketing / showcase list, mobile leading-image row.

navbar.$description: Top Navbar height across surface densities.

mobile.$description: 44 px — iOS / Android default; touch-target floor.

popover.$description: Popover / DropdownMenu minimum widths. Floating panels can grow beyond; these are the floor.

md.$description: 280 px — default; mixed menu with icons + labels + shortcuts.

lg.$description: 360 px — wide Popover; rich content (Combobox results, color picker).

rail.$description: 64 px — icon-only collapsed rail. Touch floor honored by item padding.

thumb.$description: 18 px — round draggable handle; tactile under-cursor feel without obscuring track marks.

track.$description: 4 px — track height. Hairline-rounded; filled region uses accent.

table.$description: Table row heights across density tiers. Cell horizontal gap lives in `space.table.cell.{gap,compact}` (per ADR 0014 — Apple Sport pattern, column gap constant when type scales).

regular.$description: 44 px — default operator-table row (matches touch floor).

tree.$description: TreeView row heights. Indentation per depth-level applied via padding-left (16 px per level by convention).
